note: acte de fiducie des obligations à 9,750 % 2031 (pièce 4.1 du 8-K du 14 avril 2026), définition des crédits des véhicules dédiés (Future SPV Credit Agreement) : la dette liée au contrat OpenAI est réputée conforme si son ratio prêt/valeur ne dépasse pas 75 % (90 % si OpenAI OpCo LLC, sa société mère ou une filiale est notée investment grade ; ratio prêt/coût d'au plus 100 % pour une dette d'équipement) et si la dette totale de la société et de ses filiales restreintes liée au contrat OpenAI ne dépasse pas 7,0 Md$ : capacité d'endettement adossée au contrat d'OpenAI, aucun montant tiré
quote: It is agreed and understood that the requirements set forth in the immediately preceding proviso shall be deemed satisfied with respect to any Indebtedness of any Future SPV or Existing SPV incurred in respect of the OpenAI Contract and any Refinancing Indebtedness thereof so long as (1) any such Indebtedness so incurred by one or more Future SPVs or Existing SPVs in respect of the OpenAI Contract has an LTV Ratio of no greater than 75.0% (or (i) to the extent OpenAI OpCo LLC (or any Parent Entity or Subsidiary thereof) has an Investment Grade Rating, such Indebtedness has an LTV Ratio of no greater than 90.0% or (ii) to the extent such Indebtedness solely consists of Equipment Indebtedness, such Indebtedness has an LTC Ratio of no greater than 100%) and (2) the aggregate principal amount of all Indebtedness of the Company and its Restricted Subsidiaries in respect of the OpenAI Contract is equal to or less than $7.0 billion.
